verdict.rationale: The documented CLIs (the Oz CLI and the Warp Agent CLI) run and manage AI agents locally, remotely or in the cloud. None of the evidence shows a CLI or IPC interface for controlling the Warp terminal itself, such as opening windows or tabs, sending text to panes, or querying session state. The new settings file offers programmatic control over settings only, which is not the scripting and control this story asks for.
